extracted.name: My Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
extracted.description: Do you have over ripe bananas? My Banana Bread recipe is extremely delicious! It’s moist, easy to make, and you can whip it up in one bowl! Perfect with your morning cup of coffee or as a snack! BEST CHOCOLATE CHIP BANANA BREAD IN THE SOUTH. 😉
instruction_lines: Pre heat oven to 350 degrees. Grease 9x5 loaf pan
Sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, nutmeg, cinnamon and salt. 》》DO NOT SKIP THIS STEP!《《

With stand mixer or hand held mixer, cream together the butter and the sugar. Add 2 eggs but 1 at time. With mixer on low add in the buttermilk and vanilla until batter is just combined. NOTES☆☆ 》》 If you don't have buttermilk it's just ¼ cup milk and tsp vinegar and lit sit for couple minutes.《《
Next add your flour mixture and add the bananas and chocolate chips and mix until incorporated.
Lastly, in your prepared pan pour in batter and bake for 1 hour. Let cool before slicing.
